import socket
left,right=socket.socketpair()
payload=b"payload /tmp/not-a-resource"
assert left.send(payload)==len(payload)
assert right.recv(128)==payload
assert left.sendmsg([payload])==len(payload)
assert right.recvmsg(128)[0]==payload
left.close();right.close()
